description: Ultimate Combo Chart is an advanced Power BI visual designed for flexible business analysis, management reporting and interactive data exploration. Combine multiple charting and analytical capabilities in a single visual, including clustered, stacked, 100% stacked, diverging, waterfall and stacked waterfall charts, together with line overlays and advanced comparison tools. Key capabilities include: • Interactive hierarchical navigation and drill analysis • Waterfall and stacked waterfall analysis • Multiple comparison connectors and difference arrows • Drag-and-reposition comparison annotations • Interactive category reordering • Target and variance analysis • Growth, percentage change and CAGR comparisons • Secondary-axis support • Advanced labels, formatting and analytical controls • Smooth chart and state-transition animations Ultimate Combo Chart is designed to support both detailed analytical work and executive reporting while reducing the need to combine several separate visuals. All functionality can be evaluated in Power BI Desktop. A license is required to remove the Ultimate Combo Chart watermark when reports are published for use in Power BI Service. Developed and supported by Dynamic Evolution Strategies.
